nodes.title: KIX Finance: version the synthetic finance projection and authority contract
nodes.spec:
Objective: produce a versioned draft ADR and typed numeric contract for derived finance projections over the adopted stage 5 / stage 6 source, not a new economic writer. Define source-event/operation/order/claim/advance identity, per-asset amounts and registry binding, source cut and projection watermark, debit-credit conservation, correction linkage, duplicate/gap/UNKNOWN states and schema revision. Reuse F01-F04 and lifecycle 0.6 without rewriting legacy fixtures, captured semantics or first results. Coverage map names existing mock/FSM/adapter tests and gaps. Account labels are synthetic roles; chart-of-accounts/legal debtor/creditor/revenue/tax/reserve/interest classifications and statutory retention stay UNDETERMINED, with User plus finance/accounting/legal/provider owners named. Numeric simulation semantics can be decided under the existing Astra path; missing product policy has no default. If the ADR would introduce a command, authoritative ledger/result or change approved semantics, record options and stop for actual adoption before dependent implementation. Acceptance: draft revision plus positive/negative numeric and mapping vectors, authority/decision matrix and nonclaims; approved semantics references are explicit, unresolved fields have HOLD behavior.
